All i64 values with no representability precondition and every byte count/buffer. Count 1..8 and enough space serializes the low 8*count bits and preserves suffix; count zero/>8 produces integerOverflow, and valid-count insufficient space assertionFailure. Original concrete default/callee bodies; x86_64 default features/debug extraction.

The unsigned reference word equals the original 32-bit pattern modulo 2^24. Original concrete default/callee bodies; x86_64 default features/debug extraction.
